properties.name: HQC-128 (Hamming Quasi-Cyclic Key Encapsulation Mechanism)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(w * n) encoding/decoding, ring degree n=17669, w=66, w_r=75, w_e=75
properties.fips_standard: NIST PQC Round 4 Candidate (FIPS Standardization Track)
properties.algebraic_structure: Quotient Ring F_2[X]/(X^17669 - 1) concatenated with Reed-Muller and Reed-Solomon codes

properties.name: Dense-by-Sparse Polynomial Multiplication over F_2[X]/(X^n - 1)
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(w * n / 64) 64-bit word XOR shifts; Space: O(n) bits, n=17669
properties.ring_modulus: Polynomial ring modulo X^17669 - 1 over GF(2)
properties.algorithm_variant: Cyclic bit-rotation and vectorized accumulation of sparse vector non-zero coefficient indices

properties.name: ARM Scalable Vector Extension 2 (SVE2 Bitwise Operations)
properties.throughput_bounds: Vector Length Agnostic (128 to 2048-bit VLEN in 128-bit increments)
properties.register_dependency: Scalable Vector Registers (Z0-Z31) and Predicate Registers (P0-P15)

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Bitwise XOR Zn and Zm, then right-rotate 64-bit doublewords in result by immediate #const into Zd
Three-way bitwise XOR (Zd = Zn ^ Zm ^ Zk) across all scalable vector lanes

properties.operation: Drives public key encryption (u, v) generation and decapsulation ciphertext syndrome evaluation

properties.vector_width: Scalable processing of 64-bit word blocks over GF(2) polynomial vectors using VLEN-wide SIMD

properties.stage: Combined cyclic shift accumulation step for sparse multiplier coefficients
Parallel multi-operand GF(2) polynomial coefficient array accumulation

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write scalable vector register containing 64-bit cyclic shifted bitmask limbs
Read/Write scalable vector registers during 3-input sparse accumulator XOR reduction

evidence.reference: Hamming Quasi-Cyclic (HQC) Specification (NIST PQC Round 4 Submission)
ARM Architecture Reference Manual Supplement, The Scalable Vector Extension 2 (SVE2)
